shortDescription: Manages MTU settings on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: jumbo_max
options.description: Maximum frame size. The default value is 9216. The value is an integer and expressed in bytes. The value range is 1536 to 12224 for the CE12800 and 1536 to 12288 for ToR switches.

options.name: jumbo_min
options.description: Non-jumbo frame size threshold. The default value is 1518. The value is an integer that ranges from 1518 to jumbo_max, in bytes.

options.name: mtu
options.description: MTU for a specific interface. The value is an integer ranging from 46 to 9600, in bytes.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.
